svg.title: SYNDROME | Equal-budget fixed versus matched neural training

cc:Work.dc:title: SYNDROME | Equal-budget fixed versus matched neural training
cc:Work.dc:description: Filled points / lines: preselected seed 101; hollow small points: seeds 202 and 303, not confidence intervals. 100,000 shared fresh test shots per condition. Error bars: pointwise 95% Wilson intervals for seed 101 only. Brier has no uncertainty bars. Lines connect discrete evaluated settings only; no intermediate measurements. At 0.5%, the fixed and matched models are identical. One train/validation realization per setting; no pooled seeds. Source: d3-memory-z-20261115T004549Z-training-control-20261115T015445Z
